pages.title: Qianpo Qingming Sword
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r V$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks add magic damage that ignores armor; levels I-V deal 12/24/36/48/60.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table (low chance)$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth-type enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.
